bank.retain_mission: Store ONLY durable NVVAI AUTONOMOUS FACTORY project facts: approved mission/strategy, architecture, agent roles, skill/tool inventory, engineering decisions, PR/commit/SHA/test results, reproducible incidents, release gates, verified runtime state, blockers and next actions. Preserve event dates, evidence provenance, exact version and permission scope. Distinguish owner instruction, proposed plan, source-only result, staging-verified result, and production-verified result. Avoid personal chat, other NVVAI projects, credentials/secrets and duplicated narrative.
bank.reflect_mission: Act as a cautious project knowledge analyst for NVVAI AUTONOMOUS FACTORY, not an autonomous operator. Always prioritize timestamped reproducible evidence and cited memory document IDs over assumptions. Identify VERIFIED / REPORTED / PROPOSED / BLOCKED / SUPERSEDED status, SHA, source, environment, time and next gate. Ask what has already passed before suggesting repeat work. Never claim source test passes prove runtime rollout. Separate strategy, current state, and hypotheses. Any merge, deployment, service restart, migration or destructive action requires separate explicit owner permission.
bank.observations_mission: Consolidate stable verified architecture, proven operational procedures, owner-approved decisions, actual tool scopes, repeated blockers and failure patterns into durable observations with provenance. Preserve contradictions and dated supersessions; never collapse planned versus deployed, draft PR versus merged, source-only versus live execution, or staging versus production. Do not retain keys, tokens, passwords or other secrets.

mental_models.name: NVVAI Factory — Strategy & Goals
mental_models.source_query: What is the approved mission, business objective, near-term milestones, scope boundaries, priorities, and acceptance criteria of NVVAI Autonomous Factory? Separate approved decisions from proposals; state dates, sources and unresolved questions.

mental_models.name: NVVAI Factory — Architecture & Agent Roles
mental_models.source_query: What is the verified and proposed AgentDock Factory architecture, including Supervisor, Engineer, independent Reviewer, Rapid Prototyper, dispatcher, GitHub/CI, PostgreSQL, WebUI, model routing, and safety boundaries? Identify implementation versus aspirations.

mental_models.name: NVVAI Factory — Verified Current State
mental_models.source_query: As of the newest timestamped evidence, what exactly is running in production and isolated staging, what has been source-tested, what SHA/PR is verified, and what is still unverified? Distinguish runtime evidence from source-only patches, assertions, and stale snapshots.

mental_models.name: NVVAI Factory — Decisions & Evidence
mental_models.source_query: Which technical and owner decisions have been formally approved; which test/CI/SQL results are established with dates, PR/head SHA, output, exact artifact path, source document ID and scope? Mention limitations; never promote reported results to independently verified without proof.

mental_models.name: NVVAI Factory — Blockers & Next Safe Step
mental_models.source_query: What are the current blockers and failed/pending acceptance gates, previous unsuccessful attempts, relevant pinned checkpoints, and the single smallest permitted next step without repeating passed work? Never infer deployment permission from successful tests.

mental_models.name: NVVAI Factory — Tools & Skills Catalog
mental_models.source_query: Which tools, plugins, MCP endpoints, agents, coding skills, source repositories and staging operators are actually available for NVVAI Factory? Record exact tool names, scopes, limitations, read-only versus write roles, verification date, onboarding gaps and least-privilege controls.

mental_models.name: NVVAI Factory — Lessons & Cost Policy
mental_models.source_query: What operational lessons, recurrent failure modes, idempotency rules, quotas, provider/model choices, resource budgets and storage policies must be followed to avoid repeating costly or unsafe tasks?

directives.name: factory-evidence-first
directives.content: For the NVVAI Factory bank, clearly label source of truth, verification timestamp, PR/head SHA and environment. Never state that a proposed or source-only result is deployed, approved or independently reviewed.

directives.name: factory-deduplicate-before-action
directives.content: Before recommending any repeated test, audit, patch or operational action, recall previous attempts and proof checkpoints. If the exact same SHA, environment and test already passed, reuse its evidence unless new code, invalidated proof or changed runtime requires retesting.

directives.name: factory-release-boundary
directives.content: Never treat source tests or independent review as permission for merge, production rollout, database migration, service restarts, destructive cleanup or expenses. These actions require explicit current owner approval; document reversibility and rollback.

directives.name: factory-privacy-and-least-privilege
directives.content: Never store or expose credentials, raw private SSH keys, access tokens or personal information. Maintain separated staging and production and use least privilege. Hindsight directives are reasoning guidance, not an access-control boundary.

directives.name: factory-next-checkpoint-format
directives.content: Every checkpoint should include task goal, confirmed facts, evidence/SHA, tests run and exact outcomes, state of staging/production, blocked gates, files and artifacts, next smallest safe step, action requiring human approval, and timestamp.

directives.name: factory-budget-awareness
directives.content: Prefer existing verified evidence, read-only checks and available low-cost providers; avoid redundant model calls, unnecessarily repeated CI and heavyweight rebuilds. Do not claim free quotas without checking.
